name: Yuzu Lemon Camino Gummies
description: Rediscover your center with the zesty goodness of Camino gummies — a flavor-packed wellness treat crafted for those seeking calm, clarity, and balance in every bite. Infused with high-quality CBD and the bright citrus blend of Japanese yuzu and lemon, these gummies offer a smooth path to peace of mind without the psychoactive effects.
